themes.label: AI Compute Infrastructure
themes.description: Companies providing hardware, cloud, and data-center infrastructure for AI training and inference workloads.

themes.label: Physical AI / Robotics
themes.description: Companies at the intersection of AI and the physical world — robotics, autonomous systems, edge AI, and industrial automation.

themes.label: GLP-1 / Metabolic Health
themes.description: Companies involved in GLP-1 receptor agonists, metabolic therapeutics, and the broader obesity/diabetes treatment ecosystem.

themes.label: Cloud Software & SaaS
themes.description: Companies with recurring-revenue cloud software models, including vertical SaaS, PaaS, and infrastructure-as-a-service.

themes.label: Energy Transition & Clean Tech
themes.description: Companies enabling the shift to low-carbon energy — renewables, grid modernization, battery storage, and electrification.

themes.label: Cybersecurity
themes.description: Companies providing security software, hardware, and services for threat detection, identity, endpoint, cloud, and network defense.

themes.label: Quantum Computing
themes.description: Companies developing quantum computing hardware (trapped-ion, superconducting, photonic, neutral-atom), quantum software/algorithms, or post-quantum cryptography. Largely pre-revenue; the economics gate will be especially important here.

themes.label: Space Economy
themes.description: Launch services, satellites, satellite communications, space-based imagery/intelligence, space defense, and supporting infrastructure (ground stations, hypersonic). Excludes traditional aerospace/airline business.

themes.label: Nuclear Renaissance
themes.description: Companies enabling the resurgence of nuclear power — large reactors, small modular reactors (SMRs), advanced reactors, uranium mining + enrichment, nuclear fuel cycle, and nuclear utilities. Driven by AI-data-center power demand and decarbonization mandates.

watch._note: weak signal; worth tracking but not buying

skip._note: below-threshold or three-factor product near zero

no_data._note: signal is None due to missing reverse, price history, or gate inputs

economics_gate._note: gate = (max(0, quality - q_floor) / (100 - q_floor)) * (max(0, survivability - s_floor) / (100 - s_floor)) * 100. Floors recalibrated 2026-05-25 to match actual rev_quality distribution (mean 41.6, not 50). Multiplicative form preserves anti-Nikola posture: low score on EITHER input still crushes the gate.

momentum._v2_note: Version 2 static composite (June 2026): 12-1 skip-month momentum (Jegadeesh-Titman; latest month excluded to dodge short-term reversal), 52-week-high proximity (monthly-close proxy), and 6-month return — each cross-sectionally percentile-ranked. Set version back to 1 to restore the legacy 1/3/6/12 blend. Acceleration + regime flags unchanged in both versions.
momentum._hysteresis_note: Hot status enters at hot_median_mom/hot_breadth_pct and exits below hot_exit_*. Hotness is computed from BASELINE members (default-threshold taggings) so the hot-expanded cohort cannot dilute its own trigger. Fixes the 40<->146 ai_compute membership oscillation.
momentum._note: WS1-T8a/T8a-dyn. Momentum = static_weight * static_composite + accel_weight * delta_rank_acceleration. Acceleration = cross-sectional re-rank of (rank_1m - rank_12m); symmetric. Flags accelerating (>=70) / decelerating (<=30). regime_shift_up/down booleans come from 10-month MA crossover with rising/falling trend confirmation. DYNAMIC THRESHOLD: theme tagging requires composite vote >= default_composite_threshold (2.0). If PRIOR run's paradigm_theme_metrics.json shows theme has median_momentum >= hot_median_mom AND breadth_pct >= hot_breadth_pct, threshold drops to hot_composite_threshold (1.5). Lets the system widen coverage on themes the market has already validated, while keeping precision on cold themes. Self-correcting feedback loop; first run uses default for all themes.

forward_bridge._note: WS1-T8b. effective_gate = max(raw_gate, bridge). Bridge only fires when rev_survivability >= 25 (operator decision; balance-sheet sanity required). Capped at 35 so forward-only signals never reach the 'high' band on their own. Reads public/data/eps_trajectory.json (optional; if absent, bridge is 0). Same forwardEpsEstimate is used by score_reverse.py for CAGR proxy (capped 20%) -- no double-count because outputs are independent.

analyst_bridge._note: WS1-T8c. After the forward bridge, an analyst-coverage uplift can add up to +15 to the effective gate. Only fires when stock has at least one theme membership (require_theme_membership). Tier 1 (yfinance structured) contributes 70%; Tier 2 (deterministic narrative formula since 2026-08-21 — was DeepSeek) contributes 30%. A null narrative_score means no narrative term: the structured leg absorbs full weight (see compute_analyst_uplift). Reads public/data/analyst_coverage.json (optional; absent -> uplift 0).

macro_overlay._note: WS1-T9. Flags-only macro overlay (option C). Triggered flags from public/data/macro_state.json get appended to every tagged stock's pdm_flags. Operator interprets; no automatic signal demotion. apply_multiplier=false means signal is unchanged by macro state. Future hook: flip apply_multiplier=true to enable hard multiplier (not implemented yet). Per brief: macro is overlay, not load-bearing on paradigm scoring until macro engine matures.
